name: nuclear receptor binding SET domain protein 2

function.text: NSD2 encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase NSD2. Annotated molecular activities include histone H3 methyltransferase activity and histone H3K36 dimethyltransferase activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and double-strand break repair.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); Rauch-Steindl syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Plasma cell myeloma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
